measuredSpectrum.source: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 709: HR 5602; VizieR III/202

gaps.reason: the spectrum ends at 757.5 nm; the last value is held to 780 nm, where the observer adds little

measuredSpectrum.note: Ground-based photoelectric scans from Alma-Ata, 322.5 to 757.5 nm in 5 nm steps, in absolute flux. The catalogue gives no observation dates.

crossCheck.disagreement: The Gaia DR3 XP color differs from the Kharitonov color by 45 levels. The star is G 3.24, brighter than the G 4 under which Gaia's spectra can be saturated (De Angeli et al. 2023, A&A 674, A2; color.mts XP_SATURATION_G), so the Kharitonov color is used.
